title: Accounts Payable and Receivable Officer
description:
Sewell Wallis is currently working with a fast-paced South Yorkshire retail business that is now looking for an Accounts Payable and Receivable Officer to join their finance team in Barnsley. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, takes pride in getting the detail right and is confident managing a varied transactional finance workload.

You'll play an important role in supporting the day-to-day finance function, taking ownership of Accounts Payable and Receivable, while also having the chance to be involved in month-end processes and financial reporting.

What will you be doing?

You'll be providing day-to-day support across a broad range of transactional finance duties, including:
- Performing daily reconciliations of company bank accounts
- Processing supplier invoices and credit notes, matching invoices to purchase orders and goods received, and maintaining an accurate purchase ledger.
- Obtaining and reconciling monthly supplier statements, investigating disputed invoices and liaising with suppliers to resolve queries.
- Reviewing and monitoring purchase orders and setting up new supplier accounts, ensuring bank details are verified in line with company procedures.
- Reviewing credit card expenditure and ensuring expenses are correctly coded and supported by the appropriate documentation.
- Supporting month-end processes, including accruals, prepayments, fixed asset accounting and balance sheet reconciliations.
- Assisting with financial analysis, reporting and the preparation of management accounts as your experience develops.
- Gaining exposure to audit and VAT-related processes while continuing to develop your technical accounting knowledge.

What skills are we looking for?
- Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including the confident use of SUMIFS and XLOOKUP and/or VLOOKUP.
- A good understanding of purchase ledger processes, supplier invoices and payment runs.
- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate financial records.
- Strong communication skills

What's on offer?
- A competitive Salary of c 30000
- Excellent long-term progression opportunities
- Pension Contribution

Apply below or contact Jemima for more information.

To apply, please send your CV, quoting our reference and specifying which website you saw this position advertised on. Due to the high volume of applications, please accept that if we have not responded to your application within seven days, your application has not been successful. Sewell Wallis is a specialist recruitment company with a vast amount of experience in our industry. We offer permanent, temporary and interim recruitment support for accounting and finance, human resources and business support positions. We recruit at all levels within finance, from Purchase Ledger Administrator and Credit Controller level through to Financial Controller and Director positions. We are well situated to cover all of South Yorkshire, West Yorkshire and Manchester. Please visit our website for more information on accountancy and finance jobs and human resources or business support positions.

title: Assistant Credit Controller
description:
Assistant Credit Controller
Location: Barnsley

We are currently recruiting for an Assistant Credit Controller to join a busy finance team based at their head office in Barnsley.

This is a varied role within the credit control function, offering the opportunity to support customer accounts, resolve queries and work closely with both internal teams and the wider sales department.

Key responsibilities:
- Preparing applications for payment using Excel.
- Resolving customer queries and investigating account discrepancies.
- Working closely with the area sales team to support payment processes.
- Providing copy invoices, proof of delivery documents and completion certificates.
- Supporting cash allocation.
- Liaising with internal departments to resolve account queries.
- Completing account reconciliations.
- Providing general support to the wider credit control team.

What we are looking for:
- Excellent communication skills and a confident telephone manner.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Good attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- A positive, flexible and proactive approach to work.
- The ability to work under pressure and meet strict deadlines.
- A reliable team player who can communicate effectively with people at all levels

This would suit someone with previous experience in credit control or a finance administration role who is looking to develop their experience within a busy finance team.

title: Conveyancing Assistant
description:
Conveyancing Assistant
Location: Barnsley
Salary: Competitive, depending on experience
Hours: Full-time, Monday to Friday

What's on offer:
- Car parking
- 22 days' annual leave, plus bank holidays
- Workplace pension
- A friendly, approachable residential property team
- Ongoing training and development
- Staff wellbeing initiatives, including workplace flu vaccinations

An established law firm in Barnsley is looking for a Conveyancing Assistant to join its Residential Property team. The team supports clients with a range of matters, including sales, purchases, remortgages and transfers of equity.
This is a great opportunity for someone with conveyancing experience who enjoys helping clients and keeping transactions moving. You'll work closely with the team's fee earners and provide practical support throughout the conveyancing process.

Key responsibilities
- Assisting fee earners with residential sales and purchase transactions
- Opening files and completing client care, identity and anti-money laundering checks
- Preparing and reviewing contracts and other property documents
- Liaising with clients, solicitors, estate agents and mortgage lenders
- Requesting searches and helping to progress enquiries
- Keeping clients updated and maintaining accurate file records
- Assisting with exchange, completion and post-completion tasks

You'll have experience in a residential property role and a good understanding of the conveyancing process. You'll be organised, attentive to detail and confident communicating with clients and other parties. A proactive approach and the ability to work well as part of a team are also important.

This long-established Barnsley law firm serves clients across South Yorkshire. Its Residential Property team is known for providing a friendly, personal service and guiding clients through each stage of moving home.

If the above opportunity sounds of interest, and you would like to discuss further, please get in touch with Ashleigh O'Hagan at SJC.

title: Training Coordinator
description:
A vacancy has arisen within the marketing department for a Training Coordinator to assist the Group Training Support Manager in the administration and delivery of the new starter inductions, and administration of other internal training requirements. The position will be based at Barnsley Head Office. You will join them on a full-time, permanent basis, and in return, you will receive a competitive salary.

As one of the UK s leading manufacturers of Kitchen, Bedroom and Bathroom fitted furniture, our client has had unsuppressed growth, with over 50 years experience. Their emphasis is on providing a high standard for all their products and the services they offer. They are currently seeking the very best people, to further strengthen their position within the industry by appointing dedicated individuals to share in their success.

The key responsibilities of their Training Coordinator:
- Deliver the Company Induction every Monday to all company new starters.
- Deliver all Temp-to-Perm inductions for transferred agency workers as required.
- Coordinate communications and ensure required processes are completed for all new starters.
- Coordinate all bookings, travel, and appointments for field-based new starters during their 12-week induction period.
- Keep all general induction materials and resources up to date.
- Manage enrolments onto employee compliance and induction training on the Learn 365 training platform.
- Coordinate internal and external training sessions for employees.
- Maintain employee training records.
- Assist with new product launch training and other corporate events as required.
- Provide occasional cover for the Office Services department.
- Provide occasional assistance with general HR administration tasks.
- Other duties as may arise at the request of the Group Training Support Manager.

In order to succeed in this Training Coordinator, you must have:
- Previous experience in a training role would be an advantage but not a prerequisite.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills.
- Excellent time keeping and time management skills.
- Proven organisational and administration skills.

You must be:
- Able to communicate confidently with people at all levels, in a friendly manner.
- Able to work under pressure and maintain deadlines.
- Self-motivated and willing to work as part of a dynamic team.
- Have excellent organisational, written and numerical skills.
- Be computer literate.

This position will be rewarded with a competitive salary. In order for you application to be taken further please state your required salary.

If this sounds like the perfect opportunity for you and you d like to become their Training Coordinator then please click apply today don t miss out, they d love to hear from you!

title: GP Receptionist
description: We are pleased to offer opportunity for a new team member to join our Reception Team at Walderslade GP Practice. The practice is in Hoyland, Barnsley and is an extremely busy practice with lots of phone calls, lots of visitors and a great deal of variety on a day to day basis. The role involves working 5 days per week (Monday to Friday) basis 37 hours in total. The Reception staff all take a variety of roles including call handling, arriving patients at the front desk and general administration. Main Responsibilities: - Ensuring that patients receive a high level of customer service while accessing the most appropriate service for their needs. Communicating clearly and confidently with patients concerning their appointments and treatment, test results and ensuring professionalism, sensitivity and confidentiality at all times. Communicating with staff and external agencies on behalf of the practice. Dealing with general enquiries from patients, relatives and the public. Provide general assistance to the practice team and provide general administration support, including involvement with data entry, filling, and making outbound telephone calls to patient when required.
